requirements_summary: Scale: target index ~25M original documents -> ~30M vectors after chunking
Latency: perceived response for search results <= 250-300ms p95; reranker target p95 <= 250ms
Throughput: peak expected 200-350 QPS during market hours; sustained 40-80 QPS off-peak
Cost sensitivity: procurement target <= $0.015 blended per query for standard search path (embedding + ANN + rerank)
Model preferences: prefer open models for embeddings, smaller efficient reranker model (distil-bert style) for cost; willing to accept Redwood-verified quantized variants
Routing/fallback: want dedicated capacity primary, auto-fallback to hosted compatible variant in a secondary EU region during incidents
Security: EU data residency mandatory, bring-your-own-key (KMS/HSM) mandatory, SSO (SAML), audit logs retained 7 years
Integration: connectors to internal Vault, internal metadata store, and signaling for re-index on nightly ETL jobs
